measurement_contract.counter_log_disclosure: Fixed before import/freeze; all external raw logs retained. Output display bound is not log deletion, memory subtraction, relaxed RSS, or leak attribution.

terminal_preconditions.suffix_rule: launch1 uses empty suffix; launchN>1 uses -launch-NN
terminal_preconditions.status_capture_rule: Collect the command's real exit/stdout/stderr. Save parsed exact status as a new review artifact, not into an already sealed raw run. Require final task Ready/state3, instances[], result0, matching task/launch/output and final supervisor return0; preserve any previous unsuccessful launch separately.
terminal_preconditions.return_record_limit: return.json has actual_process_exit_not_yet_observed=true; it is not terminal scheduler or native ownership proof
terminal_preconditions.deletion_rule: If a task is later deleted, retain terminal status first and task-deleted.json. This recipe does not perform deletion.
terminal_preconditions.missing_artifact_rule: Record INCOMPLETE/GAP and stop final sealing. Do not manufacture a capture, dataset, summary, exit or PASS from existing files, tails, launch receipts or vanished processes.

validator_reuse.then_require: exact_git_bytes=true; count49; map equals frozen campaign source_files, not merely overlapping entries or equal counts; expected closure/profile; actual process exit0
validator_reuse.writes: one exclusive new verification report only

validator_reuse.precondition: Exact campaign source map equals live map and each context/source-files map; invoke with campaign-pinned Python console executable.
not_sufficient_alone: omitted dependencies in historic lane maps

call_sequence: require dataset == existing dataset.json and summary == existing summary.json
validator_reuse.interpretation: measurement PASS is not GT06 acceptance

validator_reuse.writes: stdout report only; coordinator captures exit/stdout/stderr in a new review artifact

exact_equality: Set of paths plus every per-file hash, not subset/count equality
Campaign source_files equals current campaign.source_files() after load_fixture
Every selected attempt context.source_files and source-files.json equals campaign map
Campaign and selected-run source/studio copies match every listed hash
Native runtime source set and generated project/input mappings remain checked by assemble_run
Compare each inherited lane's complete declared map independently; inspect new imports/data/runtime branches relevant to that lane before calling that map complete
source_policy.functional_reuse: Driver-only S71 changes do not automatically invalidate unchanged functional lanes. Retain original source hashes and exact test invocations. A relevant changed/missing dependency creates a lane-specific gap; never rewrite historic source to current or automatically reopen accepted GT03-05.
source_policy.historical_causal_exception: S65 fault/repair artifacts intentionally preserve older project/trace/service states. Preserve their exact historic frozen sources and causal receipt; S69 managed replay verifies current functional runtime. Do not demand historic fault source equal repaired current bytes, and do not treat that exception as authority to mix benchmark sources.

selected_campaign_collection.selection: campaign-capture.json runs[0..9].capture; one complete attempt per index, attempt1..3; row run_id and path must match; twenty unique host/editor (pid,process_start) identities
selected_campaign_collection.per_run_membership: run-capture.json plus every key in run-capture.json#/artifacts, preserving exact bytes/size/hash; the capture does not list itself
selected_campaign_collection.unselected_attempts: Enumerate only bounded run-00..09-attempt-01..03 slots, list every existing nonselected slot and all retained artifacts in a separate forensic inventory after terminal. Include stop/failure/cleanup/exit proof and explicit missing-artifact rows. Never append its samples to a selected run.
selected_campaign_collection.historical_campaigns: S68/S69 partial campaigns and S70 campaign01/02 remain under original source/failure labels; index preserved summaries/raw locators. They are never eligible S71 measurements.
selected_campaign_collection.stop_semantics: Forced STAGE_STOPPED/BENCHMARK_STOPPED plus checked cleanup is separate evidence. It is not natural target exit0; process absence and wrapper exit are not substitutes for missing native exit records.
selected_campaign_collection.supervisor_supplement: Campaign capture omits sibling supervisor roots. Explicitly hash all named launcher artifacts for every launch, plus task XML hash/request/registration/instance/principal/source/python/pythonw relationships, terminal scheduler statuses and deletion receipts if present.

inherited_evidence.raw_selector: raw_files keys are studio-relative, values are sha256

inherited_evidence.scope: historic fault/repair/replay causal chain and perf diagnostic; retain original source maps/receipts/logs/captures; not benchmark

inherited_evidence.selector: runs[*].raw_root + '/' + each runs[*].artifacts key; metadata sha256,size_bytes
inherited_evidence.classify_each_root: three service adversaries plus outer owners; managed replay plus driver; owner smoke; historical incomplete S68 campaign03 prefix

inherited_evidence.limits: stale PNG mutation is negative evidence; Stop native stopped status is distinct from outer/helper exit0

inherited_evidence.join: repair-replay.json + verified original repair02 receipt + selected-config hash + current replay runtime/raw report/captures

inherited_evidence.scope: natural, Stop and setup-failure owner records; unchanged owner dependency projection only

inherited_evidence.selector: runs[*].raw_root + '/' + each runs[*].files key; preserve original metadata
inherited_evidence.scope: task natural/Stop/manual-launch2 and nested owner legacy/composed diagnostics, original source pins; no full measurement claim

inherited_evidence.expand: explicit raw/evidence references from these reports and indexed file maps after terminal; retain negative101/warnings and collector recovery metadata as diagnostic
inherited_evidence.scope: cap100 source/configuration and exact byte provenance; negative case does not become clean PASS

test_invocations.skip: recorded unrelated symlink skip; preserve exact test and reason

test_collection_rule: For each invoked suite bind invocation/source map/runner hash, test IDs and full stdout/stderr, units-host/capture actual target/helper exits and tree proof. Counts above are reported history, not newly verified results. Keep all skips/failures and reasons. Never sum overlapping suites or replace older evidence's source with HEAD. Include S68 journal-contract03 and earlier U70 diagnostics only under their own invocations when referenced by a final requirement row.

fault_coverage.s60_scope: actual native MemoryError with target/wrapper17 and closed-zero ownership in accepted shared Blender primitive; not a Godot OOM playthrough
fault_coverage.s64_scope: unchanged shared runner deadline/nonzero/live-child/bounded-disk/log handling plus explicit one symlink skip
fault_coverage.s69_scope: GT06 persistence/UNKNOWN/ownership/admission/quota/slow I/O/priority Stop consumers and native congestion/reconnect
fault_coverage.later_gates: General scheduling/cross-app activation GT07; physical Android install/launch GT08. Neither replaces pending GT06 measurements or final critics.

hash_domains.raw_file: sha256(exact file bytes), with size_bytes; preserve empty files and native float spellings
hash_domains.source_map_closure: sha256(UTF8(concat(path + NUL + lowercase_sha256 + LF for path in ordinal sorted map keys)))
hash_domains.source_path_rule: Preserve studio-relative 49-map closure as its own domain; a repository-prefixed union has a different closure and must be named separately.
hash_domains.profile: sha256(canonical compact sorted JSON bytes generated by existing profile code); no added newline
hash_domains.runtime_snapshot: Use producer/verifier's declared runtime snapshot algorithm, never substitute file or review-map hash
hash_domains.review_manifest: sha256(exact final manifest bytes); manifest itself excluded from its own member lists
hash_domains.portable: Own raw-byte file hashes and closure; mapping includes raw_origin_sha256 and transformation/source path. Byte-preserved files can share hashes; normalized/rendered/redacted views cannot claim raw equality.
storage_rules: Explicit path/size/hash references; no symlink/reparse/traversal/case aliases
Merge duplicate identical domain+path entries once; conflicting hash/size is a gap, not last-writer-wins
Preserve source closure by lane when historic generations differ
No generated .godot/cache added to Git; declared raw cache evidence remains locally hash-addressable when already referenced
No secret/token/global environment introduced into portable review; any necessary redacted view has a separate hash domain and raw locator

required_sections: campaign exact pins and completed artifact refs
source_domains per benchmark and inherited lane
raw_files with exact sizes/hashes and local locators
portable_files and origin mappings if a view exists
verification commands and actual verifier exits
forbidden_shortcuts: accept from a PASS banner or scheduler dispatch
copy an old critic signature onto a new source
change native profile, thresholds, batch count, wall limit or warm baseline
make a portable view stand in for unavailable raw bytes
final_manifest_design.review_rule: Both critics read-only and independent, both explicitly bind the identical final manifest/source hashes. Keep critic files outside the reviewed manifest to avoid a hash cycle. New source/candidate bytes require new review of those bytes. Coordinator acceptance remains separate.
final_manifest_design.current_disposition: No final dataset/package or acceptance is established by this recipe.
